name: Airabot Chatbot
author: intertoons

sections.description:
Airabot Chatbot puts your AI assistant on your WordPress site in four clicks.

The usual way to embed a chatbot is to copy a script tag out of a dashboard and paste it into your theme’s footer — where the next theme update quietly deletes it. This plugin removes that step entirely. Connect your Airabot account once, choose which chatbot to show, and it is added to every page of your site automatically.

How it works

  1. Click Connect with Airabot and approve your site.
  2. Pick one of your chatbots from a list of the ones on your account.
  3. Choose a widget style — chat bubble or search overlay.
  4. Save. Your chatbot is live.

Changing to a different chatbot later, switching styles, or switching it off again is a single change on one settings screen. No code, at any point.

Your password is never entered into this site

You sign in on Airabot’s own website, not in WordPress. Your site never sees, sends, or stores your Airabot password.

What your site receives instead is a read-only access token, and the limits on it are enforced by Airabot’s servers rather than by this plugin:

  • It can list the chatbots on your account, which is what fills the dropdown.
  • It cannot create, edit or delete your chatbots.
  • It cannot read your conversations or your customers’ data.
  • It cannot change anything about your account or billing.

Disconnect from the plugin’s settings screen at any time, or revoke a site’s access from your Airabot dashboard. Uninstalling removes the token from your database completely.

Widget styles

  • Chat bubble — a speech-bubble button in the bottom-right corner that opens a standard chat panel.
  • Search overlay — a centered pill button that opens a full-screen overlay, with voice support.

Both are configured on the Airabot side — your chatbot’s colour, icon, greeting and label all come from your dashboard, so changes there appear on your site without touching WordPress.

Good to know

  • Works with any theme — the widget is added to the footer, not to your templates.
  • Nothing is loaded on your public pages until you pick a chatbot and switch it on.
  • No third-party fonts or trackers are loaded in your admin area.
  • Translation-ready, and every string is translatable.

Requirements

An Airabot account with at least one chatbot. Sign up free at https://airabot.in

External service

This plugin connects your site to Airabot, a third-party chatbot service operated at https://airabot.in — the plugin is not functional without it.

It contacts Airabot in two situations:

  1. In your admin area, when you connect the plugin. Clicking Connect sends you to https://airabot.in/authorize, where you sign in to Airabot and approve this site. Your Airabot password is entered on Airabot’s own website and is never sent to, or stored by, your WordPress site. On approval, Airabot hands back a one-time code, which your site exchanges server-to-server for a read-only access token via https://airabot.in/api/ragcb-site-connect. That token is used only to fetch your chatbot list from https://airabot.in/api/ragcb-bots; it cannot modify chatbots or read conversations. Your site’s URL and title are sent so Airabot can show you which site is requesting access.

  2. On your public pages, once you enable a chatbot. The plugin adds a script tag loading https://airabot.in/widget.js (or widget-overlay.js). Your visitors’ browsers then load that script and communicate directly with Airabot to run the chat, which means Airabot receives visitor data such as IP address and any messages they send to the chatbot.

Please review Airabot’s terms of service and privacy policy at https://airabot.in before use, and disclose the chatbot in your own site’s privacy policy as required in your jurisdiction.

Bundled third-party assets

The Sora typeface is bundled with this plugin (assets/fonts/) under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see assets/fonts/LICENSE.txt. It is served from your own site — no font requests are made to Google or any other third party.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and upload the plugin zip.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the Airabot menu in your admin sidebar.
  4. Click Connect with Airabot, approve this site, then pick a chatbot and a widget style and save.
sections.faq:
Do I need to edit my theme?

No. The plugin adds the chatbot to your site’s footer automatically.

Where is my Airabot password stored?

Nowhere — this plugin never sees it. You sign in on airabot.in, and your site receives only a read-only access token limited to listing your chatbots. The token is never exposed to visitors, and is deleted when you disconnect or uninstall the plugin. You can also revoke a connected site at any time from your Airabot dashboard.

My chatbot is not showing up.

Check that “Show the chatbot on my website” is ticked on the Airabot settings page, and that the selected chatbot is not marked “inactive” — inactive chatbots do not display until you activate them in the Airabot dashboard. Also clear any caching plugin’s cache after saving.

Can I show the chatbot on some pages only?

Not in this version. The chatbot is shown site-wide.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Load the widget with wp_enqueue_script, use wp_safe_redirect for the connect step, update tested-up-to.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: one-click account connection via airabot.in (no password handling), chatbot picker, bubble and overlay widget styles, site-wide embedding.
